artifact.path: social-posting (candidate packet: five skill candidates mined from a LinkedIn post-operations thread)

decision_question: Which recurring procedures should become or change public social-posting packages, and what must each build close first?
acceptance_criteria: Family safety contract (draft-only, or approval-gated acting)
At least three realistic eval cases
Portable core with labeled host adapters

shared_model_or_source_limits: All five roles ran on the same model family with the same packet; agreement is correlated evidence.
The packet summarized the source thread; reviewers did not inspect raw screenshots or logs.
LinkedIn Help and the User Agreement block automated retrieval; the automated-methods clause was read from a third-party capture dated Nov. 3, 2025.

key_findings: C1 overlap claim partly contradicted: existing account-level browser skills already hold composer and comment typing mechanics
UI mechanics are stale-prone; use label prechecks and freshness dates, not keystroke counts
C4 is a preference unless made a toggleable, measurable profile
Acting package conflicts with the family's text-only charter
No handoff contract from post to carousel to publish; define a publish bundle
Composer and comment editors have opposite Enter semantics
Schedules need an IANA time zone
User Agreement prohibits automated creation and commenting; approval does not change that, so manual handoff must be a full path
Carousel renderer must block network, disable JS, escape text, and check accessibility
First scripted package in the family will meet Shield review

concordance: material agreement on C1 and C2 approve-with-limits, C3 and C4 as changes to existing packages, C5 defer

falsification_hypotheses.outcome: Partly accepted: kept in social-posting with a scoped, package-named exception; a separate family was rejected as heavier than the risk.
Mitigated, not disproven: exception names one package and forbids routing before approval; regression case post-this-no-acting added. Seeded multi-run test not executed.
Accepted and fixed: composer, document, schedule, and comment mechanics now live in the package's own browser-adapter reference.
Accepted: user-marked lines are flagged, not merged; AGENTS.md convention reworded to keep one deliberate line without stacking.
Partly accepted: framed as a density rule tied to the existing density principle; staccato and off profiles honored. Residual disagreement recorded.
Accepted: comments default to the off profile; eval comment-beats-untouched added.
Tested and fixed: JS disabled context still detects vertical overflow; horizontal and footer checks added; render test covers both.

falsification_hypotheses.target: carousel min font, contrast, sidecar, claims
falsification_hypotheses.outcome: Fixed: all sizes at or above 24px with a unit test, panel contrast checks, pages-text.md sidecar, unsourced-number warning.

falsification_hypotheses.target: first comment belongs to post composition
falsification_hypotheses.outcome: Accepted: implemented as an optional section of okhp3-linkedin-post; comment skill routes there; counterpoint must be openly voiced by the author as a role.
Accepted: handoff is the default mode; operator mode is opt-in with a one-time risk statement.

test_results: build_carousel tests: 11 passed (Python 3, Playwright 1.56.0, Pillow 12.3.0) on 2026-11-09

negotiator.decision: approve-with-limits for C1, C2, C3, C4; defer-for-evidence for C5
decisive_evidence: D3, D7, D8 were blocking and are fixed with tests or self-contained references
Manual handoff default resolves the strongest safety objection without dropping the operator path
unresolved_items: D2 seeded routing test not run
D5 whether a default-on cadence profile is neutral remains a judgment
LinkedIn document limits and current UI labels unverified by primary retrieval

limitations: No live with/without-skill benchmark or unseen holdout; evidence_status remains not-run for every eval suite
UI observations are from one locale and date and expire at revalidate_after
follow_up: Run the D2 seeded routing test
Re-verify LinkedIn Help limits and the User Agreement text in a browser
Revisit the content-calendar candidate after more occurrences
Optionally consolidate the account-level DM and profile browser skills after a neutrality scrub
